summary: Iteration 193 — verified Phase-4 server-side paging on 7 endpoints, digest recipients settings CRUD, and leaderboard extras (top_won / biggest_open_quote). Backend 14/14 pytest passing (backend/tests/test_iter193.py). Frontend all 4 Store & Inventory tabs and all 3 Budget Commitment tabs render pager/search testids with correct counts; digest settings dialog opens with 17 role checkboxes, 26 user checkboxes, digest-user-filter, digest-sales-dept-head, digest-extra-emails, digest-resolved and digest-settings-save; save persists (extra_emails value round-trips and resolved recount shows 3 recipients: director@erp.com, gm@erp.com, test-iter193@example.com); leaderboard cards render lb-topwon-* and lb-openquote-* blocks. Digest defaults restored (roles:[sales_manager,sales_head,director,general_manager], include_sales_dept_head:true, extras:[]). test_pm@erp.com cannot access /app/sales-reports (route-level access denied — no 'sales_reports' read permission); digest-settings-btn absent for PM.
critical_code_review_comments: finance_phase3_router.bill_without_grn: paginate_list search keys include both 'bill_no' and 'invoice_no' but the output only carries a 'bill_number' field derived from invoice_no OR bill_number. Searching 'bill_no' key is a no-op. Consider adding 'bill_number' to search keys and dropping the alias.

inventory_phase2_router.stock_inward_report: `total_value` is computed on ALL matched rows (correct for report totals), but rows in-memory are also processed for GRN enrichment BEFORE pagination which is fine while capped at 5000 (Motor .to_list(5000)). If the report ever exceeds 5000 the totals silently truncate — surface a warning header or add a hard cap breach guard.

sales_leaderboard_router.compute_leaderboard: `top_won` aggregation matches created_at in-month when won_at/updated_at missing, but if won_at is present but for a prior month it can still include quotes whose current month created_at matches — logic ok but subtle. Add a comment for future maintainers.

sales_digest.save_digest_settings drops invalid emails silently — good — but neither the response nor UI shows a validation message about dropped emails. UX nit: return dropped list alongside settings so UI can toast.

PM/test_pm@erp.com is blocked at /app/sales-reports by the ProtectedShell (missing 'sales_reports' read perm), so the DigestSettingsDialog visibility guard is functionally OK but the frontend never renders the SalesLeaderboard for PM. Guard is transitively enforced but not by the visibility rule itself — worth verifying if any lower-role sales user has read access without super_admin/director role because DigestSettingsDialog should still be hidden for them.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Store & Inventory 4 pagers + Budget Commitment 3 tabs + digest settings dialog + leaderboard extras + PM RBAC negative case)

seed_data_creation: Digest settings temporarily changed to include extra_emails=[test-iter193@example.com, ops@example.com]; ALL RESTORED via PUT to defaults (roles=[sales_manager,sales_head,director,general_manager], include_sales_dept_head=true, user_ids=[], extra_emails=[]) at end of tests (both backend pytest and frontend flow). Digest send generated real email_outbox rows for 2026-08 via POST /api/sales/leaderboard/digest/send.
